Descriptions

[SOLID AND DURABLE]Made of strong metal and thickened MDF materials, this living room table is very innovative and fashionable, quite durable to use at home for a long time. The design of the round top combined with the metal legs can ensure the maximum stability of the coffee table. [SMART & UNIQUE DESIGN]The modern round coffee table set includes 2 small tables, and the nesting combination allows you to easily clip them together or use them separately. Compact size and lightweight, easy to move and carry. You can place these side tables individually around the room or tuck them into each other for easily accessible coffee and snacks. Perfect for living room, bedroom, balcony, small spaces, etc. [SAFETY DESIGN]Circular design without table corners, avoid hurting unnecessary bumps. This table is designed with non-marring floor mats to protect floors from scratches, dents and other possible damage. [SMALL COFFEE TABLE]This coffee table is designed with a size of 70*70*47cm/45*45*40cm, ideal for small spaces. Lightweight but stable. Flexible enough to move around. If you live in a studio apartment or dorm, this coffee table is a great choice. NESTING DESIGN FOR SPACE SAVING: This set of round coffee tables can be used individually for different purposes, such as lamp table, side table, bedside table. Or we can stack these two small round coffee tables together to save space and get a sophisticated design. STORMABLE STRUCTURE FOR STABILITY AND DURABILITY: With the sturdy gold-look metal frame, these functional tables can reach a load capacity of up to 30 kg. EASY TO ASSEMBLE: With our clear assembly instructions, it will be easy for anyone to assemble this set of 2 side tables. All parts and assembly instructions are included.
